SELECT d.* FROM database_resource d
d.is_visible=TRUE AND d.status='ENABLED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM database_data_type x JOIN data_type t ON t.id=x.data_type_id WHERE x.database_id=d.id AND t.code=#{type})
AND (LOWER(d.name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.db_zh_title,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.db_en_title,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%'))
ORDER BY d.id

SELECT t.*,r.relation_role,r.relation_note FROM data_type t JOIN database_data_type r ON r.data_type_id=t.id WHERE r.database_id=#{id} AND t.is_visible=TRUE AND t.status='ENABLED' ORDER BY t.sort_order,t.id
SELECT t.*,r.relation_type,r.relation_basis FROM online_tool t JOIN database_tool r ON r.tool_id=t.id WHERE r.database_id=#{id} AND t.is_visible=TRUE AND t.status='ENABLED' ORDER BY t.id
